paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of turns of inner monologue and the EM score (%) for different models. The x-axis is labeled “Turns of Inner Monologue” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “EM (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The first line, representing SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic), is red with ‘x’ markers, starting at approximately 21% at 0 turns and increasing to approximately 48% at 6 turns; it exhibits a steady upward trend with data points at (1, 32%), (2, 38%), (3, 41%), (4, 43%), and (5, 46%). The second line, representing SIM-RAG (lite), is blue with ‘x’ markers, beginning at approximately 18% at 0 turns and rising to approximately 31% at 6 turns; it demonstrates a steady, gradual increase with data points at (1, 21%), (2, 24%), (3, 26%), (4, 28%), and (5, 30%). The third line, representing Naive Gen, is green with ‘x’ markers, starting at approximately 20% at 0 turns and remaining at approximately 22% across all values of the x-axis, from 0 to 6 turns.
